message: Rename the full completed-turn type from `Turn` to `MaterializedTurn` (breaking SDK source change) and make `Turn` the union `MaterializedTurn | DeferredTurn` so consumers explicitly narrow before reading `responseParts`; the wire format is unchanged for clients that do not declare `deferredTurns`.
details: // Narrowed to MaterializedTurn — safe to read turn.responseParts
